name: Under The Scarlet Tree!
source:
You come to a strange tree in what you believe is a Dream... With the tree you find a girl, and have an interesting talk.

Why is this mysterious girl so weird?  ̶W̶h̶y̶ ̶h̶a̶s̶ ̶e̶v̶e̶r̶y̶t̶h̶i̶n̶g̶ ̶b̶e̶c̶o̶m̶e̶ ̶s̶o̶ ̶e̶x̶i̶s̶t̶e̶n̶t̶i̶a̶l̶ ̶a̶l̶l̶ ̶o̶f̶ ̶a̶ ̶s̶u̶d̶d̶e̶n̶?̶̶

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221027084258/https://scratchikata.itch.io/utstgame]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你来到一棵奇怪的树旁，觉得自己似乎身处梦境…你在树旁遇见一个女孩，并与她进行了一番有趣的交谈。

这个神秘女孩为什么如此古怪？ ̶为̶什̶么̶一̶切̶会̶突̶然̶变̶得̶如̶此̶存̶在̶主̶义̶？

[来源：[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221027084258/https://scratchikata.itch.io/utstgame]Itch.io[/url]]
